title: Prompt-CAM: Making Vision Transformers Interpretable for Fine-Grained Analysis

layout.note: A rounded model box sits in the middle with the input image and the class-prompt tokens at the bottom feeding a blue ViT and a head on top. Four rounded panels sit in the corners, each tied to the box by an elbow arrow and named by a cream tag below it: (a) top left, (b) top right, (c) bottom left, (d) bottom right.

lesson: Draw the model once in a central box, with snowflake and flame icons for what is frozen and what is trained, then fan elbow arrows out to lettered panels that each show one use on the same input photo. Carry one pastel colour per class from prompt tokens to bars to tinted names.
